title: Head Template category boundary
description: Record from the first Head Template through the final option and prove the end or wrap behavior. Do not assume Face 29, Face 31, or any other observed option is final.
requiredEvidence: First selected head|Every selected head after current maximum|Final-option or wrap evidence

title: Skipped native numbers inside observed range
description: Resolve missing observed numbers inside Face 1-Face 31: 15, 19, 20, 25, 26. Record whether each is skipped by traversal, unavailable, or simply not captured.
requiredEvidence: Controlled selected-option sequence|Notes for each missing native number

title: Standardized production-comparison pass
description: Recapture all observed and newly found heads with locked canonical settings, no eye black where possible, controlled hair/facial-hair state where possible, consistent zoom, no overlays, and required front/three-quarter/profile/rear views.

title: Review legacy frame-manifest ID mismatches
description: Review records whose direct native-number ID does not match the older derivative frame path naming. Preserve derivatives, but do not use mismatched derivative IDs as production catalog IDs.
